summary: Portuguese distinguishes ser and estar with its own boundaries; existential haver is standard, and Brazilian Portuguese widely uses existential ter.

semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: estar for many conditions and situational states
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: estar + adjective/participle for many resultant states
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: estar for many entity locations; ser also occurs in identifying/fixed patterns
semantic_map.SEM.EVENT_LOCATION: ser for event location/time in common constructions
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: impersonal haver; existential ter widespread in Brazilian Portuguese
semantic_map.SEM.ABSENCE_NONEXISTENCE: não haver / não ter existential according to variety/register
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: ordinary possession uses ter; existential ter is variety-sensitive
